subject: Proposal: term amendment for premium SLA + capacity uplift (HelioHealth)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Helio renewal — premium SLA + capacity ask (context and next steps)

Marissa / Ben,

Quick context: HelioHealth's contract is up for renewal end of December. They've been steadily increasing production usage (approx 3.5x token growth q/q) and are asking for a stronger SLA and a predictable capacity reservation to avoid throttling during batch billing cycles. Daniel and Sarah from Helio are on the thread if you want to pull in legal/finance later.

What Helio is asking for (high level):
- Premium support tier (24/7 escalation, dedicated TAM)
- Latency SLOs tightened to p95 < 200ms on inference for their "patient-summaries" route and p99 < 800ms for burst windows
- Committed reserved capacity for peak daytime window (US-EAST) with burstable headroom
- 12 month term with a billing credit or discount to offset initial migration effort

Recommended internal next steps:
1) Ben — run a capacity runbook and draft a concrete dedicated reservation spec (nodes / target throughput / canary capacity) by Monday 11/23.
2) Marissa — coordinate pricing uplift and discount matrix; suggest two options (12-mo commit discounted vs 24-mo deeper discount).
3) I'll draft a mutual action plan and attach a proposed SLA term sheet for initial review.

Attachments: SLA-term-sheet.xlsx (draft), Mutual-Action-Plan-HelioHealth.docx

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Helio renewal — premium SLA + capacity ask (context and next steps)

Priyom — thanks for the clear summary. High-level confirmation from our side:
- We need the premium support tier (engineer-level access and TAM) starting day 1 of renewal.
- Latency targets are negotiable but p95 <200ms for patient-summaries is a hard ask. p99 <800ms would be a strong win.
- We want a committed reservation that covers our normal peak (approx 6000 requests/hour during business hours) with +30% burst.
- We prefer a 12-month term but will consider 24 months for a better commercial package.

Two things we care about from contract/legal: escalation SLAs (time to respond / time to restore), and data residency (we need audit logs retained 2 years). Sarah from Legal is cc'd to coordinate.

Next steps: please share an options quote with technical specs and show the impact to our monthly committed spend.

—Daniel
Director, ML Platforms | HelioHealth
[Attachment: none]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helio renewal — sizing proposal (draft)

Looping in my quick sizing and options. I ran a back-of-envelope using Helio's telemetry; notes below are conservative but actionable.

Option A — 12-mo Reserved (recommended for minimal cost uplift):
- Dedicated pool: 4 x A100-equivalent nodes (in our infra repo these are "dedicated-4x-a100-v2")
- Target throughput: sustained 1,800 rps across the route (business-hours), burst headroom 30% (can scale to 2,340 rps for short windows)
- Latency SLOs (with prefix/KV caching): p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 720ms (measured from ingress to token stream start)
- Expected cost delta vs current hosted: +48% on monthly run-rate, 20% discount for 12-mo commit

Option B — 24-mo Reserved (lower unit costs):
- Dedicated pool: same spec but 25% lower unit price (deeper discount)
- Additional free canary capacity for safe rollouts

Notes / risks:
- Tail latency improvements rely on Helio adopting our KV cache pattern for their top-100 prompt prefixes. Need engineering effort (2 sprints) to migrate prompts.
- Audit logs/data retention: ops can retain 24 months but that needs a specific addendum (storage charge).

I'll produce a one-page quote PDF (Helio-dedicated-quote.pdf) for Marissa to use in commercial.

—Ben
Head of Dedicated Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Helio-dedicated-quote.pdf (PDF, 112 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@heliohealth.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing options and term amendment — HelioHealth renewal

Hi Daniel / Procurement team — attaching the quote and a short matrix of options. TL;DR: two buy choices with support SLA add-ons.

Option 1 — 12-month Premium: 20% discount off list for the dedicated reservation described; includes TAM, 24/7 critical on-call, and SLOs: p95 <200ms, p99 <800ms. Storage for audit logs (24 months) is billable as metered storage.

Option 2 — 24-month Premium (best value): 32% discount, includes one-time migration credit ($25k) and 90 days of canary capacity at no additional charge.

We can put the SLA addendum and the mutual action plan into a single term amendment to your Master Services Agreement to keep things simple. For legal, we can provide the addendum language and a separate audit-log exhibit.

Requesting procurement's preferred option and target signature date so we can schedule the migration window (we need two full weekends for canary + cutover).

Attachments: Helio-dedicated-quote.pdf, SLA-term-sheet.xlsx, Mutual-Action-Plan-HelioHealth.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
